description: Registry of all operational playbooks in ai-dev-standards. Playbooks are step-by-step guides for critical operations, incident response, deployment procedures, and development workflows. Now includes 14 playbooks covering ADHD support, deployment, incidents, development workflows, and system reliability.

playbooks.name: adhd-getting-unstuck
playbooks.title: Getting Unstuck (ADHD Edition)
playbooks.use_when: Feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or can't start a task

playbooks.name: backup-and-restore
playbooks.title: Backup and Restore Playbook
playbooks.use_when: Setting up backups, recovering from data loss, disaster recovery planning

playbooks.name: component-development
playbooks.title: Component Development Playbook
playbooks.description: Comprehensive guide for creating reusable, accessible, and well-tested components.

playbooks.name: incident-response
playbooks.title: Incident Response Playbook
playbooks.use_when: Production is down, critical bug affecting users, security incident

playbooks.name: mcp-development
playbooks.title: MCP Development Playbook
playbooks.description: Complete guide for creating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers from scratch using the ai-dev-standards components.

playbooks.name: monitoring-setup
playbooks.title: Monitoring Setup Playbook
playbooks.description: Comprehensive guide for implementing observability across your application stack with logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.

playbooks.name: multi-agent-systems
playbooks.title: Multi-Agent Systems Playbook
playbooks.description: Comprehensive guide for designing and orchestrating multi-agent systems with advanced coordination patterns.

playbooks.name: performance-optimization
playbooks.title: Performance Optimization Playbook
playbooks.description: Comprehensive guide for profiling, tuning, and optimizing application performance across the stack.

playbooks.name: rag-implementation
playbooks.title: RAG Implementation Playbook
playbooks.description: Complete guide for implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems from scratch.

playbooks.name: rollback-procedure
playbooks.title: Rollback Procedure Playbook
playbooks.use_when: Deployment causes issues, need to revert to previous working state

playbooks.name: security-hardening
playbooks.title: Security Hardening Playbook
playbooks.description: Comprehensive guide for implementing security best practices across your application stack.

adhd-support.description: Playbooks designed for ADHD developers to manage focus, activation energy, and overwhelm

operations.description: Operational procedures for deployment, backup, monitoring, and database management

development.description: Development workflows, best practices, and implementation guides

incident.description: Emergency response procedures for production incidents and outages

security.description: Security hardening and vulnerability prevention procedures
